fact: Libya Review reports that the National High Electoral Commission (HNEC) launched electronic voter-identity verification in municipal council elections, initially in four municipalities (Zliten, Al-Sbiaa, Brak, Al-Abrak), with devices registering voters' biometric data when voter cards are collected.
source_slug: 2024-08-19 Libya implements biometric voter verification in municipal council elections

fact: HNEC Decision 253 of 2025 adopts a regulation setting up a digital registration system by SMS and an in-person system for the voter register.

The regulation defines the voter register update as checking HNEC databases against changes in the Civil Registry Authority database, and requires applicants to hold a national number in the national number system.
